notes.title: Smarter, Smoother, Sharper
notes.content:
[p]In this update, I've focused on polishing the moment-to-moment experience without softening the edge that makes this game.. [b]Here's what's new:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Key Item Notifications[/b]
No more guessing what you just picked up! Whenever you acquire a key item, an on-screen prompt will now briefly describe it, helping you stay oriented and focused on your next task.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dynamic Puzzle Hints[/b]
Your character will now offer subtle, context-sensitive hints if you spend time trying to solve a puzzle. These hints are natural and immersive, woven into the character’s thoughts, and never give away the solution outright. They simply nudge you in the right direction, preserving the game’s challenge while cutting down on frustration.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Note Logic[/b]
Notes and clues remain a core part of the puzzle-solving experience. I’ve refined their presentation and reinforced their logic, so solutions feel earned, not cryptic. [/p][/*][/list][p]This update keeps the difficulty intact, but removes the pain points. Whether you're playing for the first time or diving back in, I hope these changes make the experience even more engaging. ːsteamhappyː[/p]

notes.title: How to Update Ethel
notes.content: Although the updates are functioning correctly, they are not being applied [b]UNTIL[/b] the player logs out of their Steam account and then logs back in. The update will then commence.

notes.title: Less back-and-forth for certain items.
notes.content: Experienced players will readily discern the alterations within the game, whereas newcomers will likely find the gameplay less laborious.

notes.title: Working Hard to Resolve Lighting Issues
notes.content: Some players may have noticed varying levels of darkness in the game, which was caused by a malfunction with the fog during the final stages of development. The fog was intended to enhance lighting effects and brighten the game. Despite efforts to rectify the issue by adjusting the player flashlight, I regret any inconvenience this may have caused for those unable to fully enjoy the experience. I am committed to resolving this issue and will be updating the Unreal Engine from version 5.2 to 5.3 in the hopes of addressing the problem. Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Reduced tedious back-and-forth objectives
notes.content: I've streamlined the game mechanics to reduce tedium and minimize the need for excessive back-and-forth retrieval of items. My aim is to enhance the overall experience for both existing players and those considering purchasing the game. Thank you for all the support.
